newsitem.title: USA: USDA to give cotton license to Callaway, others.
newsitem.headline: USDA to give cotton license to Callaway, others.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Department said Friday it planned to grant a patent license to Callaway Chemical Co, FMC Corp and Rohm and Haas Co for a cotton textile finishing process.

In a notice published in the Federal Register, the agency's Agricultural Research Service said the license was for catalysts and processes for formaldehyde-free finishing of cotton textiles with polycarboxylic acides.
The agency said it would review public comments on the proposal submitted by July 15.
USDA said it was in the public interest to license the federal government's patent rights to the process.
